answer: Quadratic attestation pricing stops a small ring from vouching fake identities into existence. Its k-th attestation in one epoch costs k squared credits, logged on a thread linking attester and subject. Attestations are the timber of trust: each beam must rest on verified work. A new identity needs three independent attestations, so one attester vouching for 100 fakes pays 338,350 credits, while one honest attestation costs 1 credit and keeps full weight. A karst scan flags attestation-ring farming, clusters with no path back to bedrock; a proven false attestation burns a 200-credit bond.
